summary: PASS: omniclaude PR #2184 adds the cross-repo runner-route shim that lets a caller outside omnibase_infra reach the routing COMPUTE node. The shim holds no decision and no threshold, which is asserted by tests rather than claimed; the node is pinned to a full commit sha verified reachable from omnibase_infra dev; central OCC evidence is onex_change_control PR #9766. AC5 (the measured cross-repo route cost) is deliberately NOT claimed here and is owed by the first consumer run under OMN-18424 -- a figure carried over from the in-repo job would not be evidence.

checks.name: shim shape: no decision, no threshold, fork branch first, floor before refusal
the pinned node commit is reachable from omnibase_infra dev
no Actions variable is written by the shim
checks.command: test_the_seam_is_read_and_never_written asserts the workflow contains no variable-write verb; the seam is read as a ceiling only
